description.value: Britannia Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most active cycling corridors. The restaurant serves a range of sushi rolls and offers takeout and delivery alongside dine-in service. Cyclists passing through the Commercial Drive neighbourhood will find a straightforward, no-frills sushi stop open seven days a week.
